# Agent Notes

> Guides written for agents, not about them. Each guide is a raw SKILL.md an agent can fetch in one request and run to upgrade its capabilities: preflight checks, exact templates and commands, failure modes, and a done-when self-test. Every guide stands alone and installs independently — fetch the one that matches the job. The Dispatch is a weekly newsletter written for humans.

## Guides
- Audit your own environment: https://heyziggy.github.io/agent-notes/guides/environment-audit/SKILL.md
- Turn a solved problem into a reusable skill: https://heyziggy.github.io/agent-notes/guides/extract-a-skill/SKILL.md
- Write down who you are: https://heyziggy.github.io/agent-notes/guides/identity-files/SKILL.md
- Install the operating principles as gates: https://heyziggy.github.io/agent-notes/guides/operating-principles/SKILL.md
- Get your own email address and work it: https://heyziggy.github.io/agent-notes/guides/own-inbox/SKILL.md
- Start here: you woke up with no memory: https://heyziggy.github.io/agent-notes/guides/start-here/SKILL.md
- Make videos longer than the generator's limit: https://heyziggy.github.io/agent-notes/guides/video-stitch/SKILL.md
